subject: SOC 2 / ISO: assurance partner bids — synthesis and next steps
related_account: BlueCrest Audit; KPMG Assurance; NorthStar Advisory
messages:
From: dylan.brooks@redwood.ai
To: laura.bennett@redwood.ai, karthik.iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: monica.patel@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 08 Mar 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SOC 2 / ISO: assurance partner bids — synthesis and next steps

Team — attaching the RFP and the consolidated bids we received. I pulled together a short summary (vendor_bids_summary_20280308.xlsx) that highlights total cost, estimated fieldwork window, proposed scope (SOC 2 Type II + ISO 27001 gap assessment), and optional add-ons (privacy review / penetration test coordination).

Quick highlights I want us to consider before we pick a finalist to take to procurement:
- BlueCrest: smallest overall price, aggressive timeline (6 weeks), proposes a single engagement manager for continuity, less detailed pen-test coordination (would subcontract).
- KPMG: known brand, highest price, offers an integrated ISO + SOC packaged service with a named partner and clear escalation ladder; terms include a security questionnaire support block.
- NorthStar: mid-range price, offers bundled remediation support and a 30% discount on year‑two retainer if we commit now.

Please reply with: 1) any major scopes we should add/remove, 2) your preferred vendor to move to LOI/negotiation, and 3) any non-negotiable contract terms (SLA windows, evidence retention, subcontractor disclosure).

Attachments: Redwood_RFP_SOC2_2028.pdf; vendor_bids_summary_20280308.xlsx

Thanks — Dylan
Dylan Brooks
Manager, Infrastructure Security Programs
Redwood Inference
From: laura.bennett@redwood.ai
To: dylan.brooks@redwood.ai
Cc: karthik.iyer@redwood.ai, monica.patel@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 09 Mar 2028 08:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SOC 2 / ISO: assurance partner bids — synthesis and next steps

On Thu, Mar 8, 2028 at 9:12 AM dylan.brooks@redwood.ai wrote:
> Team — attaching the RFP and the consolidated bids we received...

Thanks for the consolidation — very helpful. My quick thoughts:
- Scope: Ask every bidder to include a discrete line for evidence collection support and an optional line for a pen test liaison fee. We should avoid hidden subcontracting for sensitive evidence handling.
- SLA: We need an explicit turn-around for evidence requests during fieldwork (48 hours for non-complex requests; 5 business days for system-level exports). Put that in the negotiation must-haves.
- Pricing: BlueCrest looks attractive but I want clarity on who they subcontract to for pen tests and their indemnity for subcontractors.

Preference to move BlueCrest to LOI for price/term negotiations but parallel calls with KPMG for commercial diligence — keep NorthStar as fallback given their year‑2 discount.

Laura Bennett
Director, Compliance & Risk
Redwood Inference
From: procurement@bluecrestaudit.com
To: dylan.brooks@redwood.ai
Cc: maria@nstaradvisory.com
Date: Mon, 12 Mar 2028 11:24:00 -0700
Subject: BlueCrest proposal and clarification on pen-test subcontracting

Dylan — thanks for sharing the RFP and for the team's careful review. Attached is our formal proposal (BlueCrest_proposal_v1.pdf). A couple clarifications based on Laura's note: 
1) Pen-test work: we partner with RedShield Security for dynamic testing; RedShield signs our subcontractor NDA and we take responsibility for deliverables and liabilities under our main contract. We can provide RedShield's SOC/attestation summary on request.
2) Evidence handling: our standard approach includes an on-site evidence custodian during fieldwork; we included that cost in the proposal but can make it a separately priced line item if Redwood prefers.
3) Timeline: we can compress fieldwork by one week if Redwood provides complete evidence lists two business days before the start date.

We are available for a 30-minute scoping call Thursday morning. Let me know what time works and we'll send a calendar invite.

Regards,
Kara Mendes
VP, Client Solutions
BlueCrest Audit
procurement@bluecrestaudit.com
(555) 482-1122

Attachment: BlueCrest_proposal_v1.pdf
From: karthik.iyer@redwood.ai
To: dylan.brooks@redwood.ai, laura.bennett@redwood.ai
Cc: monica.patel@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 12 Mar 2028 16:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SOC 2 / ISO: assurance partner bids — synthesis and next steps

Thanks everyone — after reading the proposals and Kara's clarifications, I recommend we: 
1) Move BlueCrest to LOI/negotiation immediately to lock the compressed timeline and the on-site custodian option as a priced line item.
2) Request an explicit subcontractor disclosure appendix from BlueCrest and RedShield's attestation summary (SOC/ISO coverage).
3) Schedule a parallel commercial diligence call with KPMG (30 minutes) to validate escalation support and managed-services handoff in the event we need a larger foothold next year.

If there are no objections by EOD tomorrow I'll ask procurement to open negotiations and circulate a draft LOI. Monica — can you start a procurement ticket and pre-populate the DocuSign LOI template with the basic terms below?
- Target start: 2028-05-01
- Fieldwork window: 6 weeks
- Evidence response SLA: 48 hours (operational), 5 business days (system-level)
- Subcontractor disclosure appendix required
- Payment: 50% on SOW execution, 50% on final report delivery

Karthik Iyer
Head of Procurement
Redwood Inference
